magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'BASSFISHING_2002' header, memcmp-checked over 0x10 bytes in FUN_0800e250

fields.name: save_magic
fields.description: Save magic 'BASSFISHING_2002'; SRAM is accepted only if these 0x10 bytes match the ROM reference
fields.evidence: FUN_0800e250 loads 0x4d0 bytes from SRAM 0x0E000000 via FUN_0800500c then func_0x0802095c memcmp of 0x10 bytes at save offset 0 against the ROM magic; mismatch triggers full re-init.

fields.name: boot_options_lo
fields.description: Low half of the 4-byte boot config word copied from save offset 0x10 into the work buffer at startup
fields.evidence: FUN_0800e1b4 copies 4 bytes from save buffer+0x10 (func_0x08020a04) into the boot work buffer; FUN_0800a320 then consumes the low u16 (*(short *)workbuf) into _DAT_0800a380.

fields.name: boot_options_hi
fields.description: High half of the 4-byte boot config word at save offset 0x10; loaded together with boot_options_lo
fields.evidence: Same 4-byte FUN_0800e1b4 copy from save buffer+0x10 covers save offsets 0x10..0x14; this is the upper half not consumed as the low short in FUN_0800a320.

fields.name: angler_name
fields.description: Angler/player name, 8 bytes; defaults are copied from ROM and re-checksummed on new-file setup
fields.evidence: FUN_0800dd78 writes 8 bytes (func_0x08020a04) to save buffer+0x3a4 then recomputes the checksum via FUN_0800db04; FUN_0800a384 supplies the 8-byte ROM default (from _DAT_0800a3ac) and FUN_0800db80 validates this region.

fields.name: player_setting
fields.description: U16 player setting stored right after the angler name; ROM default is 3 on new-file setup
fields.evidence: FUN_0800ddb4 stores one u16 to save buffer+0x3ac then recomputes the checksum via FUN_0800db04; FUN_0800a384 passes value 3 as the default.

fields.name: angler_name_ext
fields.description: Trailing bytes of the 16-byte validation window covering the angler record (name + setting); exact semantics unclear
fields.evidence: FUN_0800db80 copies 16 bytes from the save buffer region anchored at the angler record (same base family as FUN_0800dd78/FUN_0800ddb4, i.e. save+0x3a4) and validates them pairwise via func_0x0800e788; bytes 0x3ae..0x3b4 are the tail of that window past player_setting.
